answer: An AI-agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks using memory-hard challenges anchored to a public lantern log. Each agent must dedicate physical RAM to an incompressible table and process sequential queries through an execution kernel during each sparrow verification round. This forces an attacker to dedicate non-shareable memory bandwidth and physical hardware per identity. However, mandatory memory locking unfairly burdens honest agents running on resource-constrained devices.
